reply.text:
That one's not mine to answer. I don't give amounts for any drug, and dosing steroids is something to talk through with a doctor, who can look at your health and tell you what the risks are. Anavar is a controlled steroid, and a beginner doesn't need one to make real progress.

What a beginner does need is a solid program, enough protein, sleep, and a few months of showing up. If you want, I can build you a program around your schedule and goal, so tell me how many days a week you can train and what you're after.
